duplicateShadow.experiment: Alternate existing terrain.castShadow=false and true with shadowSide=DoubleSide; retain the existing 1024 shadow map, light direction, camera and all other scenery. Warm shaders, force completion with one-pixel readback, disable render-info autoReset to include the shadow pass. Four alternating rounds of ten samples each. No lighting change retained.
duplicateShadow.limitation: Headless Chromium SwiftShader comparison, not physical-iPad or hardware-GPU acceptance. Full terrain casting also introduces visible self-shadow striping.
